meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器,完成打开网页、填表、截图与取数等重复流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要在网页上重复点按、填表、登录或抓取数据
copy.tagline_en: Drive a browser automatically to open pages, fill forms, take screenshots and pull data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you repeat clicks, forms or data pulls on websites

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会写并运行小脚本去操作浏览器:打开网页、点击、填表单、截图、抓取数据、测试网站,页面状态在多次脚本之间保留。
howto.when: 当你要求做浏览器操作时触发,比如「打开某网址」「点击」「填表」等说法,或要求抓取数据、测试网站时。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截图,让我看看页面
say.note: 启动浏览器并返回一张截图

say.text: 在登录页填上用户名和密码,然后提交
say.note: 写入输入框并点击提交

say.text: 抓取这个列表页每一页的数据
say.note: 按原文方式捕获并重放网络请求

howto.what_en: Claude writes and runs small scripts that drive a browser: open pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots, scrape data, and test sites. Page state persists across script runs.
howto.when_en: Triggers on browser interaction requests, such as "go to [url]", "click on", or "fill out the form", or when asked to scrape data or test a website.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot so I can see the page.
say_en.note: Starts a browser and returns a screenshot.

say_en.text: Fill in the username and password on the login page, then submit.
say_en.note: Types into the fields and clicks submit.

say_en.text: Scrape the data from every page of this listing.
